name: claude-startup-finance
description: Read-only Claude tools for startup finance from The AI CFO newsletter, organized by theme at aircfo.github.io/claude-startup-finance. Start with the free Finance Brain Starter Kit (a download on the docs site, no install); all-systems-go connects Stripe, Ramp, and Mercury and adds the workflows that read it. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Stripe, Ramp, Mercury, Intuit, or Anthropic.

plugins.name: all-systems-go
plugins.description: Cross-system finance workflows, named for airCFO's All Systems Go series on the startup back-office stack. Adds Stripe, Ramp, and Mercury connectors plus workflows that read your Finance Brain first (runway & burn, revenue reconciliation, board metrics) and meta-skills to author your own. Pairs with the free Finance Brain Starter Kit.
